Perfect for Multi-Cat Homes – Individual Tracking for Each Kitty! Got multiple cats? Low-Maintenance & Travel-Friendly! Hate constantly changing litter? The 6L waste bin holds up to 15 days' worth of waste for one cat! Connect to 2.4GHz Wi-Fi, and control the robot litter box from anywhere. Whether you're at work, traveling, or just enjoying a lazy Sunday, your cat's litter box stays clean—without you lifting a finger!
